基于 mRNA 表达的干性指数（mRNAsi）是干性基因 signature 表达矩阵的**第一主成分**，重标到 0–1 \[1\]。论文图把样本按 mRNAsi 排序，并在下方以色条堆叠已知临床特征——读者一眼看到哪些亚组处于去分化端。

## Data Preparation

真实数据中，mRNAsi 由肿瘤表达矩阵向 PCBC 干性 signature 投影得到（参考工作流的 `pcbc-stemsig` 文件）。我们直接模拟投影输出：60 个髓母细胞瘤样样本、连续 mRNAsi 与两个临床特征。

```{r load data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(1101)
n_sam <- 60
samples <- paste0("MB-", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_sam))
subgroup <- sample(c("Group3", "SHH", "Group4", "WNT"), n_sam,
                   replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.1))
metastasis <- sample(c("M0", "M1"), n_sam, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.6, 0.4))
# 潜在干性 z 分：Group3/Group4 高、WNT 低、M1 更高（同参考图）——
# 效应加完之后再重标到 0..1，且不再排序，否则数值与临床特征脱钩
z <- rnorm(n_sam) + 0.9 * (subgroup %in% c("Group3", "Group4")) -
  0.8 * (subgroup == "WNT") + 0.3 * (metastasis == "M1")
mRNAsi <- pnorm(z)

clin <- data.frame(sample = samples,
                   mRNAsi = mRNAsi,
                   Subgroup = subgroup,
                   Metastasis = metastasis)
head(clin, 3)
```

## Visualization

### 1. 按 mRNAsi 排序的样本与临床色条

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.1mRNAsiHeatmap
#| fig-cap: "样本按 mRNAsi 排序（顶部渐变行）+ 亚组与转移色条；去分化端富集 Group 3/4 与 M1。"
#| out.width: "95%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3

ord <- order(clin$mRNAsi)
mat <- rbind(mRNAsi = clin$mRNAsi[ord])
rownames(mat) <- "mRNAsi"
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("#445EAD", "white", "#B31E22"))

ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  mRNAsi = anno_simple(mat["mRNAsi", ], col = col_fun),
  Subgroup = clin$Subgroup[ord],
  Metastasis = clin$Metastasis[ord],
  col = list(Subgroup = c("Group3" = "#B31E22", "SHH" = "#529B40",
                          "Group4" = "#383D8E", "WNT" = "#EABF00"),
             Metastasis = c(M0 = "#dcddde", M1 = "#700353")),
  annotation_name_side = "left")

Heatmap(mat, name = "mRNAsi", top_annotation = ha_top,
        col = col_fun, cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE,
        show_column_names = FALSE, show_row_names = FALSE,
        border = TRUE, width = unit(18, "cm"))
```

### 2. 各分子亚组的 mRNAsi

```{r}
#| label: fig-1.2mRNAsiBox
#| fig-cap: "各髓母细胞瘤亚组的 mRNAsi；标注 Kruskal-Wallis p 值。"
#| out.width: "65%"
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5

p_kw <- kruskal.test(mRNAsi ~ Subgroup, data = clin)$p.value
sub_order <- c("WNT", "SHH", "Group4", "Group3")

ggplot(clin, aes(factor(Subgroup, sub_order), mRNAsi, fill = Subgroup)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Group3" = "#B31E22", "SHH" = "#529B40",
                               "Group4" = "#383D8E", "WNT" = "#EABF00")) +
  labs(title = sprintf("mRNAsi by subgroup (Kruskal-Wallis %s)",
       ifelse(p_kw < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p_kw))),
       x = NULL, y = "mRNAsi", fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

::: callout-tip
**Practice tips**

-   mDNAsi（甲基化版指数）版式完全相同——换掉顶行重跑即可。
-   色条必须与指数同序；给未排序的矩阵加注释会毁掉整张图的要点。
-   真实数据用 `prcomp()` 把 log2 表达矩阵投影到 PCBC signature 取 PC1（`mRNAsi = PC1 / max(PC1)` 重标到 0–1）；参考工作流自带 signature 文件。
:::

## Application

干性指数用于跨分子亚组、分期和治疗方式比较；高 mRNAsi 肿瘤通常是队列中去分化、侵袭性一端。排序色条图是标准的总览。

## Reference

\[1\] Malta TM, Sokolov A, Gentles AJ, et al. Machine learning identifies stemness features associated with oncogenic dedifferentiation. Cell. 2018;173(2):338-354.e15. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2018.03.034

\[2\] Xiaofan Lu, et al. FigureYa: A Standardized Visualization Framework for Enhancing Biomedical Data Interpretation and Research Efficiency. iMetaMed. 2025. doi:10.1002/imm3.70005
